  *****NOTE FROM THE CITY*****

  COVID-19 PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS

Due to the existing COVID-19 health emergency and the social distancing measures currently in effect, and pursuant to
Assembly Bill 361, please note that members of the public will be allowed only to observe and address the City Council
Meeting of November 9, 2021, at 2:00 p.m. by telephone, video and other electronic means, as follows:

  1.  Written Public Comments: Members of the public may choose to submit comments electronically for
  consideration by the Inglewood City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Finance

  aallen@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure distribution to the members of the Legislative Body prior to
  consideration of the agenda, City Clerk staff will check and print emails prior to arriving in the Council
   1.  Written Public Comments: Members of the public may choose to submit comments electronically for
  consideration by the Inglewood City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Finance
  Authority/Parking Authority/Joint Powers Authority (Legislative Body) by sending them to the City
  Clerk/Secretary at athompson@cityofinglewood.org, and Deputy City Clerk at
  aallen@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure distribution to the members of the Legislative Body prior to
  consideration of the agenda, City Clerk staff will check and print emails prior to arriving in the Council

  should indicate the meeting date and agenda item. Comments received will be made part of the official

  2.  Viewing and Listening to the Meeting without Making Public Comments:

minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  November 9, 2021

  The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a special meeting on Tuesday,
  November 9, 2021, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into at the hour of 2:00 p.m.
  The City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk and
  Mayor Butts; and
  Absent:  None.
  City Authority officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  David Esparza  Assistant City Manager/CFO
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk
  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS. Mayor Butts inquired if there were any
  persons present who wished to address the City Council on any item on the Agenda.
  There was no response.

125  RESOLUTION NO. 22-09 ADOPTED – AUTHORIZING THE CITY TO
  IMPLEMENT TELECONFERENCE PUBLIC MEETINGS FROM NOVEMBER
  9, 2021, THROUGH DECEMBER 9, 2021, FOR THE CITY COUNCIL AND ALL
  OTHER LEGISLATIVE BODIES, PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL 361. Staff
  report dated November 9, 2021, was presented recommending adoption of a resolution
  authorizing the City to implement teleconference public meetings from November 9,
  2021, through December 9, 2021, for the City Council and all other Legislative Bodies,
  pursuant to Assembly Bill 361.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that
  Resolution No. 22-09 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA AUTHORIZING THE CITY TO
  IMPLEMENT TELECONFERENCE PUBLIC MEETINGS FROM
  NOVEMBER 9, 2021 THROUGH DECEMBER 9, 2021 FOR THE CITY
  COUNCIL AND ALL OTHER LEGISLATIVE BODIES PURSUANT
  TO AB 361

  be adopted. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

301  CATEGORICAL  EXEMPTION  AFFIRMED  –  CALIFORNIA
  ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT (CEQA) COMPLIANCE; AGREEMENT
  NO. 22-035 APPROVED – SANSMARK, INC. Staff report dated November 9, 2021,
  was presented recommending affirmation of a Categorical Exemption (CE) in compliance
  with the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA).

  It was moved by Council Member Dotson, and seconded by Council Member Morales
  that the City Council does hereby: 1) Affirm Categorical Exemption; and 2) Approve and
  authorize execution of Agreement No. 22-035 with Sansmark, Inc. to advertise displays
  on the Donut Sign located on the building at 805 W. Manchester Boulevard, Inglewood,
  California 90301. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.
   November 9, 2021

301  AGREEMENT NO. 22-034 APPROVED – LAMAR CENTRAL OUTDOOR, LLC.
  Staff report dated November 9, 2021, was presented recommending approval and
  authorization of the execution of a proposed Billboard Relocation and Settlement
  Agreement with Lamar Central Outdoor, LLC.

  It was moved by Council Member Dotson, and seconded by Council Member Morales
  that the City Council does hereby approve and authorize execution of Agreement No. 22-
  034 with Lamar Central Outdoor, LLC. The motion was carried by the following roll call
  vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts declared the meeting
  adjourned in memory of Beverly Tate Broadus, mother of Snoop Dogg at the hour of
  2:02 p.m.

  Approved this 7th day of December, 2021.

  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk

  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Mayor
